notes.title: Update Patch Notes - March 26, 2018
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added Dash feature (like a Megaman slide).[/b]
Just press "SPACE" ("B" on the controller) + move left or right and ....Wheeeee! :D

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11383635/efdf7fe9e0592a8153bb2e0d9806d6f759a6c7fa.gif[/img]

[b]Added "Dash Master" Achievement.[/b]
Use Dash 100x

[b]Added feature to Fall through the wooden platforms.[/b]
Just press DOWN key and if the player is currently standing on a jump-thru (wooden) platform, this action will make them fall through it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11383635/810dce847cd36bf979b63f274c65fcb023a54a93.gif[/img]

[b]Fixed F12 for Screenshots[/b]

[b]Changed GAMBLER Achievement[/b]
Use Artifact-o-Matic Machine 50 Times (before 100 times)

[b]Changed SWORD MASTER Achievement[/b]
Slay 1000 Monsters with Blade (before 5000)


[b]Enjoy the game and have a nice day! :)[/b]

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - November 30, 2016
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added:[/b] New feature to revive Your fallen friend in 2P Survival mode.
[i]If your friend die, go close to the grave (cross) and pray for him (press and keep down arrow) Remember, You must pray at least 5 seconds![/i]

Thanks to Jump Gunnington for this great idea! :)

[b]Added:[/b] Steam Overlay feature
[i]Press Shift+Tab[/i]

[b]Fixed:[/b] SwordMaster Achievement


[b]Enjoy this update! :)[/b]

p.s. If you like my games [b]Jet Set Knights[/b] or [b]Donuts N Justice[/b] and have a moment please write a review on Steam. Thank You!

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - September 25, 2016
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added Shrine of Champions.[/b]
If you have least 10 coins (tokens) you can buy blessing.
Blessing increases hero power for one stage run.

[b]Added new Achievement - FREEZEMAN42[/b]
(destroy 420 frozen monsters)

[b]Fixed "Gambler Achievement"  in Artifact-o-Matic machine.[/b]
Now you can unlock this achievement and play on machine repeatedly even if you have unlocked all the artifacts, you can still win the coins. (useful for buying blessing)

[b]Fixed "lance bug" for Bonus Stage.[/b]
Previously, you could not destroy training doll with lance.


Enjoy this update! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - August 1, 2016
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Changed Total Bankruptcy (3x poo) on Artifact-o-Matic machine.[/b]
Now, if you got 3x poo you lose only 1-3 Token (random) and not all.
If you got 3x coin, you win 1-3 token random.

[b]Added special chance to win artifact (1:6) with every token.[/b]
Before, this function was random and was harder to get any artifacts (due to hardly collected tokens).

[i]I tested Artifact-o-Matic machine today and got 4 artifacts (about 35 tokens was used)[/i]

[b]Player's mood:[/b]
The result Before update ːsteamsadː  After update ːsteamhappyː


Happy gaming! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - July 30, 2016
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Yay! Added Steam Achievements, finally! :)[/b]
[i]You can try to unlock the first 14 achievements, another will be added in the next few days.[/i]

[b]Changed[/b] Daily Bonus from 1 Token to 3,5 or 10 (random)
[i]Hope this will help you unlock all the artifacts easier.[/i]

[b]Fixed[/b] "bug" with level up and coins.
[i]Now, if you level-up, the coins/diamons will be paused and don't disappear until the level-up table is on screen.[/i]

[b]Changed[/b] Mimic Chest timing.
[i]Mimic explodes a little bit later.[/i]

[b]Added[/b] Stats for Tokens.
[i]You can check how many tokens you used.[/i]


Enjoy the game! ːsteamhappyː

As you noticed, the Steam Overlays (ALT+TAB) was added but after a few hours I found a bug there and the game sometimes crashed, so i turned this function off for now. Steam Overlays will be available in few days/weeks i hope. Thank you for understanding.

I hope you will like this update, especially with new 2P Survival mode! :)

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - February 20, 2016
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]


Added two [b]NEW[/b] local multiplayer modes, [b]Last Man Standing[/b] and [b]Domination[/b]! - [b]ADDED[/b]

[i]In the Last Man Standing mode, the last person that survives wins the round.

The objective of Domination mode is to own the most of the flags. Each captured flag generates one point every second. The player with the highest score wins the round.[/i]

Some small changes on stage design. - [b]CHANGED[/b]

Enjoy the game!

...2P Survival mode coming soon!
